title: Prism 1 Puts Linux Computer on Smart Glasses
summary: Raven Resonance has launched Prism 1, an eye-controlled standalone computer built into a pair of smart glasses running a custom Linux platform.

title: NCSC Warns of AI Ransomware Risk to UK Infrastructure
summary: The National Cyber Security Centre warns it is highly likely that AI malware will be used in a ransomware attack on UK critical infrastructure within two years.

title: OpenUK Launches First Space Tech Radar Report
summary: OpenUK released its inaugural Space Tech Radar report covering open technology projects for both Earth and space observation.

title: Reverse Game Theory Proposed to Align AI Agents
summary: Researchers are using reverse game theory to create incentives that make following rules the most rational choice for powerful AI models.

title: GE Vernova Launches Engineering Education Program
summary: GE Vernova has launched a $4.5 million education initiative in Greenville aimed at reaching 3,000 students with hands-on learning.

title: HydroWing Adopts AI for Tidal Energy Monitoring
summary: HydroWing has contracted Ecodetect for AI-driven environmental monitoring and wildlife detection at its tidal energy project in Wales.

title: Greece Unveils National Semiconductor Strategy
summary: Greece opened a draft national strategy for semiconductors and microelectronics for public consultation to expand its role in chip design and research.

title: Solar Spin-off Noak Secures Five Million Euros
summary: Imec and UHasselt spin-off Noak has raised €5 million in seed investment to industrialize perovskite-silicon tandem photovoltaic solar technology.

title: Swiss AR Motorcycle Helmet
summary: Swiss company Aegis Rider developed an augmented reality motorcycle helmet featuring navigation capabilities designed to replace traditional GPS.

title: LHC Detects Quark-Gluon Plasma in Small Collisions
summary: CERN scientists using the Large Hadron Collider found evidence of quark-gluon plasma in surprisingly small atomic collisions.

title: EVO Supercar Makes American Debut
summary: A German-engineered $3.3-million EVO supercar made its official American debut.

title: Loophole Suggests Black Holes Can Split
summary: Researchers identified a potential physical loophole indicating that extremely fast-spinning black holes could divide into two.

title: AI Image Enhancement Improves Flip-Chip Defect Detection
summary: Researchers demonstrated that AI-based image enhancement improves the detection of interconnect defects and cracks in microelectronic packaging.

title: 3D Integration Lowers Emissions of GPU Scaling
summary: Researchers modeled how 2.5D and 3D scaling in chipletized GPUs can reduce the embodied carbon emissions impact of AI data centers.

title: Meter-Scale Quantum Interconnects Link 120-Qubit Processors
summary: IBM Research demonstrated meter-scale quantum interconnects capable of linking large individual quantum processor modules.

title: Pixel: Co-Designed Mobile Manipulation Robot
summary: Researchers presented Pixel, a full-stack robot system combining a low-cost wheeled humanoid with hardware, data collection, and learning pipelines.

title: Single-Visit Screening for Cochlear Tissue Growth
summary: Scientists developed and validated a single-visit algorithm to detect tissue growth around cochlear implant electrodes without an intra-operative baseline.

title: APPlace Co-Optimizes Device Locations for Analog Placement
summary: Researchers published an analog layout automation approach that co-optimizes device locations and access points for routing-aware placement.

title: Hierarchical EEG-to-Text Decoding Framework
summary: Researchers introduced a hierarchical alignment framework for sentence-level EEG-to-text classification to aid non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.

title: TAMPAgent Unifies LVLMs and TAMP for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Researchers proposed TAMPAgent, a framework that integrates Large Vision-Language Models with Task and Motion Planning to handle partial observability in mobile manipulation.

title: WISE Improves World Action Models via Pre-Execution Selection
summary: WISE is a pre-execution selector that scores sampled rollouts from world action models to improve closed-loop success rates on robotic tasks.

title: Dynamical Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Control Systems
summary: A new framework for dynamical unbalanced optimal transport combines relaxed-control theory with a weighted superposition principle for nonlinear control-affine systems.

title: Quantum Private Information Retrieval Scheme for Forest Graphs
summary: Researchers designed an efficient quantum private information retrieval scheme for forest graphs achieving a rate of three over N using an initial GHZ state.

title: Mediating Human-Swarm Interactions Using a Robot Helper
summary: A shepherding-inspired approach demonstrates that motion primitives operating on collective shape improve human-swarm interaction performance and reduce perceived workload in virtual reality.

title: Reinforcement Twinning Framework for Actuated Systems
summary: A reinforcement-twinning framework utilizes Gaussian-process surrogates and Bayesian policy search to jointly adapt digital twin models and control policies under physical limitations.

title: Annotated ISIC 2019 Dataset Mitigates Dermoscopy Artifacts
summary: Researchers released a rigorously annotated version of the ISIC 2019 dataset featuring binary masks for hair, ink, and vignetting to support artifact-free dermoscopic deep learning.

title: Inertia Mismatch Impacts Robot Policy Learning
summary: Controlled simulation experiments reveal how inertia mismatch between heavy robot arms and manipulated objects affects the performance of reinforcement learning and behavior cloning.

title: Delay-Certified Readiness Barriers for Overactuated Multirotors
summary: A new Lipschitz-free test maintains readiness barriers for overactuated multirotors under sampled commands and varying speed-controller delays without violating safety floors.

title: ToFTouch Multimodal Sensor Combines Proximity and Tactile Sensing
summary: ToFTouch integrates time-of-flight sensors with an optics-based pressure array on a gripper to improve pre-grasp adjustment, clutter extraction, and insertion tasks.

title: GIST Improves FDD Downlink Channel Estimation via Path Structure Transfer
summary: Researchers propose Gaussian-Informed Structure Transfer, a method predicting propagation path structures from user equipment locations to reduce downlink channel estimation overhead.
